implementation: Owner logs only command kind and validated fixed/AgentError code; HTTP 409 carries the safe error code.

Transport bounds response accumulation, logs local.control.failed with operation/statusCode/code, preserves 401/403 authentication errors and carries other safe owner diagnoses as plan_local_control_failed.detail.
Existing terminated-session close caching and immutable close-result replay are retained and functionally verified.

Server reconciles control failure through the lease path and independently checks supervisor identity and worker units. Accepted work remains accepted. Missing or surviving process evidence keeps plan_closeout_failed.

Unavailable owners, including owners that die after discovery, require bound private manifest/proof records, an unloaded or inactive owner unit, and absence of the recorded PID/start/boot identity. Worker cleanup must also confirm before released_at is persisted and the unverified guard is cleared.

Recovery releases leases and workspace locks after proven cleanup while preserving historical run results; it admits a waiting successor. Alive, unknown, unreadable and failed persistence outcomes retain reservations.
Workspace wait changes log their reason. ACP wait changes log in the waiting run context and persist waitReason through the engine serial queue, so separate API processes and the UI can read it.
A terminal run retires its owner on the next one-second lifecycle observation through the existing bounded shutdown, including when native close fails. Active/paused runs remain owned.

boundaries: OS/filesystem identity, systemd commands, sockets, native execution and persistence are controlled mocks/stubs or existing in-memory fixtures. No real provider, network service, database server or subprocess chain is started.
decisions: No pages-plan-sicherung stash existed in this workspace. Existing committed PAGE-333 implementation and tests were extended; earlier ticket changes and the historical docs/PAGE-333.qa.json were preserved.
Only known product codes satisfying the required regex are accepted from the owner; arbitrary valid-looking strings become internal to avoid response-content leakage.
Lost owner proof after acceptance can recover only with independent supervisor and worker evidence. A living agent during systemd reexec still fails safely; PAGE-342 is not implemented here.
Explicit native isConfirmed:false results stay unconfirmed. No accepted verdict is reset by closeout.
No push, rebase, branch switch, deployment, live service/data or credential change. QA gates are delegated, not blocking todos.
limits: Functional unit evidence only; no live recovery or deployment claim, no full-suite/type/lint/format/coverage verdict.
